title: Molybdenum-catalysed ammonia production with samarium diiodide and alcohols or water

synthesis.procedure: In an argon-filled glove box, ethylene glycol (60.0 μL, 1.08 mmol) was added in one portion to a solution of SmI2(THF)2 (197 mg, 0.360 mmol) in THF (3.5 mL) in a 20 mL Schlenk flask. The mixture was stirred at room temperature for 5 min, then cooled and kept at −30 °C for 4 days, forming green crystals. The crystals were washed with Et2O (2 mL × 3) and dried under vacuum to afford 6·C4H8O (165 mg, 0.225 mmol, 63%). A single crystal for X-ray analysis was obtained by heat recrystallization from a THF solution of a SmI2(THF)2/ethylene glycol reaction mixture at −30 °C for 4 days.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 20 mL Schlenk flask in an argon-filled glove box
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: green crystals formed on standing at −30 °C; washed with Et2O (2 mL × 3) and dried under vacuum; X-ray crystal from heat recrystallization in THF at −30 °C for 4 days

synthesis.procedure: In a nitrogen-filled glove box, THF (6 mL) was added to a mixture of molybdenum catalyst 1a (1.7 mg, 0.0020 mmol) and SmI2(THF)2 (197 mg, 0.360 mmol) in a 50 mL Schlenk flask. Ethylene glycol (100 μL, 1.80 mmol) was added in one portion to the stirred solution, and the mixture was stirred at room temperature for 18 h. After volatiles were removed in vacuo, the solid was extracted with EtOH (5 mL). Slow addition of hexane (30 mL) to the EtOH solution afforded 7a as colourless crystals, which were collected by filtration, washed with hexane (5 mL × 3) and dried in vacuo (169 mg, 0.133 mmol, 74%). A single crystal for X-ray analysis was obtained by two-layer recrystallization (hexane onto EtOH).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 50 mL Schlenk flask in a nitrogen-filled glove box
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: volatiles removed in vacuo; extraction with EtOH (5 mL); colourless crystals by slow addition of hexane (30 mL); washed with hexane (5 mL × 3) and dried in vacuo; X-ray crystal from two-layer EtOH/hexane recrystallization

Methods, preparation of oxygen-bridged disamarium(III) complex (7a)

synthesis.procedure: In a nitrogen-filled glove box, THF (6 mL) was added to a mixture of 1a (1.7 mg, 0.0020 mmol) and SmI2(THF)2 (197 mg, 0.360 mmol) in a 50 mL Schlenk flask. Ethylene glycol (20 μL, 0.36 mmol) was added in one portion, and the mixture was stirred at room temperature for 18 h. Slow addition of hexane (40 mL) to the reaction mixture afforded colourless crystals for X-ray analysis; these crystals contain a small amount of 7b·2C4H8O. Only a small amount of 7b was isolated in pure form from the catalytic reaction using 180 equiv. (to 1a) of SmI2 and 180 equiv. of ethylene glycol.
